subject: [PATCH] mm/gup: batch PTE-mapped large folios in gup_fast_pte_range()

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Expressed skepticism about the patch's feasibility due to duplicated code between regular gup path and gup_fast path, suggesting it may be too complex to merge.

2026-10-07.patch_summary: Rik van Riel's patch to batch PTE-mapped large folios in gup_fast_pte_range() is met with skepticism and a suggestion that the code duplication between regular gup path and gup_fast path may be too complex to merge.
